description: Query the world's robot directory - 812 robots across 30 categories and 319 brands. Tools: search_robots (by category, brand, price, use case), get_robot and get_robot_full (complete specs), compare_robots (side-by-side diff), get_category, and get_job_automation_risk (robot displacement scores for 240+ professions - data available nowhere else). All reads public, no auth.

tool_signatures.name: compare_robots
tool_signatures.description: Compare two robots side by side on specs, price, and capabilities. Returns a comparison URL and key differences.

tool_signatures.name: get_category
tool_signatures.description: Get all robots in a specific category with specs and prices. Returns the full list of active robots in that category from the Geppetto directory.

category_slug.description: Category slug e.g. humanoid, cleaning, lawn, aerial, medical, security, agricultural, delivery, industrial, companion, educational, inspection

tool_signatures.name: get_job_automation_risk
tool_signatures.description: Get the Geppetto automation risk score (0-100) for any profession. Higher score means robots are actively displacing this role at commercial scale right now. Includes IFR deployment data, Oxford automation score, and McKinsey task automation rate.

profession_slug.description: Profession slug e.g. warehouse-picker-packer, delivery-driver-last-mile, registered-nurse, long-haul-truck-driver

tool_signatures.name: get_robot
tool_signatures.description: Get full specs and details for a specific robot by its slug. Returns all specifications, price, brand, description, features, and direct URL.

slug.description: Robot slug e.g. agility-robotics-digit, roborock-s8-maxv-ultra, boston-dynamics-spot

tool_signatures.name: search_robots
tool_signatures.description: Search Geppetto's directory of 300+ robots by category, brand, price range, or use case. Returns robot name, slug, category, brand, price range, and key specs.

query.description: Search term, category, or use case. Examples: humanoid, robot vacuum, lawn mower, cobot

category.description: Robot category slug. Options: humanoid, cleaning, lawn, aerial, medical, security, agricultural, delivery, industrial, companion, educational, inspection
